test_service_cache_creation: test that ServiceCache creates a directory with logs and disk subdirectories on initialization
test_service_cache_path_access: test accessing ServiceCache path using the forward slash operator to navigate subdirectories
test_service_cache_file_permissions: test creating empty files in the ServiceCache root, logs, and disk directories to verify write permissions
test_service_cache_cleanup: test that calling close on ServiceCache removes the cache directory and all created files
test_service_cache_in_memory: test that ServiceCache uses an in-memory filesystem when available and symlinks disk to a real path
